opener_concept: Elephant vs stiletto heel: same idea as pressure = force / area. A 40,000 N elephant over 0.4 m2 = 100,000 Pa; a 500 N woman over 0.0002 m2 of heel tips = 2,500,000 Pa. The surprise (a slim heel dents a floor an elephant would not) reveals p = F/A. Two numeric common-sense boxes, then the reveal names the equation.
